title: Key with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bowl' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD97A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8A93C'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- key ring hole -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#E8A93C' stroke-width='9'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#FFD97A' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='30' y='26' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#E8A93C'/>
  <rect x='30' y='27' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD97A'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='70' y='34' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#E8A93C'/>
  <rect x='70' y='35' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD97A'/>
  <rect x='80' y='34' width='7' height='14' rx='2' fill='#E8A93C'/>
  <rect x='80' y='35' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD97A'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the shaft -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#7A4A12'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#7A4A12'/>
  <path d='M47 36 Q55 43 63 36' fill='none' stroke='#7A4A12' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='3' fill='#FF9B7A' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='35' r='3' fill='#FF9B7A' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
